album_art_only.description: Show only the album artwork (no text).
album_art_only.label: Album art only

hide_album_art.description: Hide the artwork and its fallback icon.
hide_album_art.label: Hide album art

hide_when_no_media.description: Hide the widget when no MPRIS player is active.
hide_when_no_media.label: Hide when no media

local_lyrics_dir.description: Folder with local .lrc files named 'Artist - Title.lrc'; searched before LRCLIB.
local_lyrics_dir.label: Local lyrics folder

max_length.description: Maximum widget length in pixels — the text area width (long titles scroll or truncate to fit it).
max_length.label: Max length

offset_ms.description: Shift lyric timing: positive values show lines earlier, negative later.
offset_ms.label: Lyrics offset (ms)

panel_size.description: Size preset of the lyrics panel: compact (440), medium (520), large (640). The bar widget and control-center tile open this preset.
panel_size.label: Panel size

show_lyric_line.description: Show the current synced lyric line in the chip instead of the artist (title stays).
show_lyric_line.label: Show current lyric line

title_scroll.description: Scroll long titles that exceed the max length.
title_scroll.label: Title scroll

use_cache.description: Store fetched lyrics in the plugin data directory for offline reuse.
use_cache.label: Cache lyrics
